# Retry failed schedule deliveries twice

## Context

Delivery to a class can fail while the release job runs.

## Decision

Retry a failed delivery twice before reporting it.

## Consequences

A delivery can arrive up to two retry intervals late.

notes: The body states the promise, so editing it moves the content hash.

name: P04 content-v1 pins need review when an explained behavior's links change
notes: Dropping a governing rule changes what the behavior promises. RULE-ASMT-AUTH's pin is no longer required, and the behavior's own pin no longer matches. The rule, now unattached, is the CORE009 warning.

name: P04 content-v1 pins need review when an explained behavior's availability changes
notes: Availability is part of the promise. The registries add the edition so the change is valid; the request still applies, so the only problem is the review.

RULE-ASMT-AUTH.md.body:
# Require permission to assign to the class

## Constraint

The server must reject scheduling unless the assessment is published and the actor is authorized to assign it to the requested class.

notes: Front matter other than the lifecycle and review fields is content. The heading follows the title, as Core requires.

name: P04 content-v1 pins need review when an explained behavior is deprecated
notes: A record that is going away moves the content hash: it names deprecated and retired, so the guide is reviewed before readers rely on it.

name: P04 content-v1 pins stay current when an explained behavior records the basis of its approval
notes: The pins are literal content hashes of the baseline's sources. The content hash leaves approval out as it leaves status out (ADR 0020), so recording how the behavior was approved does not send its guide back to review.

name: P04 content-v1 pins stay current when an explained behavior names the requirement it formalizes
notes: formalizes says where a promise came from, not what it is, so the content hash leaves it out (ADR 0020): naming the outside requirement, or a tool renumbering its criteria, leaves the review current.

name: P04 file-v1 pins, the whole file, need review when an explained behavior is approved
notes: `hash: file-v1` pins each source's whole file, as every review before 0.13.0 does and as `intentset migrate --to 0.3` names each review that named no hash (ADR 0025): any edit to the source, its status included, needs review.

name: P04 file-v1 pins, the whole file, need review when an explained behavior records the basis of its approval
notes: A file-v1 pin holds the whole file: every byte counts, approval included.

name: P04 file-v1 pins, the whole file, of an unchanged source stay current
notes: Literal whole-file pins of the baseline's sources under `hash: file-v1`, with nothing changed: the whole-file kind still reads as current.

name: P04 a review that names an unknown hash kind needs review
notes: No pin can match a kind the implementation does not read, so the knowledge needs review rather than being trusted.

name: P04 a review with no hash pins content-v1, so approving an explained behavior leaves it current
notes: Core §9, publication §3 (ADR 0025): a review that names no hash pins content hashes, so these literal content-v1 pins hold after the behavior's approval changes its bytes.

name: P04 a review with no hash pins content-v1, so a changed body of an explained behavior needs review

notes: Publication §2: render-html drops raw HTML but checks no URL scheme, so the publisher removes a link, image or definition whose URL has a scheme other than http, https or mailto, before a page or a fragment is rendered, keeping the link text and the image's alt text. A relative URL and a #fragment have no scheme and are kept. The Markset document keeps the body unchanged; only the HTML is held to this.

reviewedAt: '2026-09-30'

The changed behavior is internal: it is counted in withheldChanged, never named.

notes: Publication §5: a rule's tip is the reason a product gives for a refusal, so a document kept under review holds it back and the help file lists the rule in withheldForReview; behavior and capability tips are carried, marked.

name: P04 a changed governing rule the knowledge does not explain is neither named nor counted

Delivery to a class can fail while the release job runs.

Retry a failed delivery twice before reporting it.

A delivery can arrive up to two retry intervals late.
